Rashid Khan Tops Global T20I Wicket Chart, Arshdeep Singh Leads Indian Bowlers

03 Nov 2026, 06:31 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Editorial Desk · Source: www.amarujala.com

Image: Amar Ujala · Photo source · Resized and letterboxed to 16:9; no AI generation

Key takeaways Who currently holds the most T20 International wickets? - **World leader:** Afghanistan’s **Rashid Khan** is listed as the bowler with the highest number of wickets in T20 Internationals. - **Indian leader:** Among India’s pace and spin attack, **Arshdeep Singh** sits

Who currently holds the most T20 International wickets?

  • World leader: Afghanistan’s Rashid Khan is listed as the bowler with the highest number of wickets in T20 Internationals.
  • Indian leader: Among India’s pace and spin attack, Arshdeep Singh sits at the top of the national tally.

The latest ICC‑approved statistics, updated through 30 October 2026, place these two players at the summit of their respective categories. No other bowler in the world or in India has surpassed their wicket counts in the format.

Why the rankings matter

  • Team selection: Coaches often use cumulative wicket totals as one of several indicators when shaping squads for upcoming series and tournaments, such as the 2026 T20 World Cup.
  • Player reputation: Holding the record enhances a bowler’s marketability for franchise leagues (IPL, BBL, CPL) and can affect contract negotiations.
  • Strategic planning: Opposing captains study these leaders to devise batting strategies, especially in the death overs where Rashid’s variations and Arshdeep’s yorker accuracy are most lethal.

How to verify the data

  • Visit the International Cricket Council (ICC) official statistics portal.
  • Navigate to the *T20I – Bowling – Most Wickets* section.
  • Filter by *All Nations* for the global list (Rashid Khan) or by *India* for the national list (Arshdeep Singh).
  • Check the “Last updated” timestamp to confirm the figures reflect matches up to 30 Oct 2026.

Practical implications for fans and analysts

  • Fantasy cricket: Players who include Rashid Khan or Arshdeep Singh in their squads can expect higher point yields based on historical wicket‑taking consistency.
  • Broadcast commentary: Analysts will likely reference these rankings when discussing match‑ups, especially when India faces Afghanistan or other strong T20 sides.
  • Youth development: Aspiring bowlers in both countries may study the techniques of these leaders—Rashid’s leg‑spin and Arshdeep’s left‑arm swing—to emulate their success.

What remains unknown

  • Exact wicket counts: The source does not disclose the precise numbers, so readers should consult the ICC database for the latest figures.
  • Future changes: Upcoming series, injuries, or retirement could shift the rankings before the next major tournament.

---

*The information above is compiled from publicly available ICC statistics and the Amar Ujala article dated 30 Oct 2026. No proprietary data or unpublished quotes have been used.*
